# PDA network v2: X25519 low-order public-key table for the HPKE public profile (R4 C2 freeze artifact).
# Status: PROPOSED for review. After review this file is immutable; changes need a new versioned file.
# Source: tink-crypto/tink-java tag v1.23.0, src/main/java/com/google/crypto/tink/internal/Curve25519.java,
#   static final byte[][] BANNED_PUBLIC_KEYS and validatePubKeyAndClearMsb (copy, clear bit 255 of byte 31,
#   compare with every row). Copyright 2017 Google LLC, Apache License 2.0; table values reproduced as data.
# Independent cross-checks (25 Oct 2026):
#   - upstream tagged source decimal values below, re-encoded little-endian;
#   - bytecode static initializer of the Gradle-cached tink-android-1.23.0.jar
#     (jar SHA256 c656918451b01c45ce5b20c7b6d4c388f956f61b3a3528e769048c8944c42f9e,
#      com/google/crypto/tink/internal/Curve25519.class SHA256 7bc3ddfd73df2e04a8d3a976457cfc92af0ac9e93d2121f9b59c6a09cdbe5822);
#   - Android StrictHpkePublicProfile.lowOrder constant.
# Row values (32-byte little-endian u-coordinates), p = 2^255 - 19:
#   LOW_ORDER_1 = 0
#   LOW_ORDER_2 = 1
#   LOW_ORDER_3 = 325606250916557431795983626356110631294008115727848805560023387167927233504
#   LOW_ORDER_4 = 39382357235489614581723060781553021112529911719440698176882885853963445705823
#   LOW_ORDER_5 = p-1
#   LOW_ORDER_6 = p
#   LOW_ORDER_7 = p+1
# Rule for both platforms, on original bytes before any provider parsing: copy, clear bit 255
#   (byte 31 AND 0x7f), reject when equal to any LOW_ORDER row. Zero is row 1; there is no eighth row.
# Expected outcome by key prefix (no inline comments; values are whole lowercase hex):
#   LOW_ORDER_n, HIGH_BIT_ALIAS_n (row n with bit 255 set) -> REJECT_LOW_ORDER
#   NEAR_MISS_n (row n with byte 15 XOR 0x01), GENERATED_POINT_id -> NOT_IN_TABLE
#   SCHEMA_BASE, SCHEMA_NEAR_MISS_n -> strict public profile ACCEPT
#   SCHEMA_LOW_ORDER_n, SCHEMA_HIGH_BIT_ALIAS_n -> strict public profile REJECT
#   NOT_IN_TABLE / ACCEPT only mean this static check passes; they do not prove a key is useful.
#   SCHEMA_* replace the raw point of PUBLIC_KEYSET_1 from network-hpke-public-keysets-v2.txt
#   (same length, every other byte unchanged); GENERATED_POINT_id is the raw point of PUBLIC_KEYSET_id.
#   TABLE_SHA256 is SHA-256 of LOW_ORDER_1..7 concatenated in order.
